query:
SELECT 1
        FROM clusters c
        JOIN items i ON i.cluster_id = c.id
        JOIN feeds f ON f.source_id = i.source_id
        LEFT JOIN feed_subscriptions fs ON fs.feed_id = f.id AND fs.user_id = $2
        WHERE c.thread_id = $1
          AND (f.is_public OR f.owner_id = $2 OR fs.user_id = $2)
        LIMIT 1
